materials_options_check.name: materials_options_check
materials_options_check.value:
case when "materials"."type" = 'multiple_choice'
            then "materials"."options" is not null
                 and jsonb_typeof("materials"."options") = 'array'
                 and jsonb_array_length("materials"."options") = 4
            else "materials"."options" is null end

tests_score_requires_finish_check.name: tests_score_requires_finish_check
tests_score_requires_finish_check.value: "tests"."total_score" is null or "tests"."finished_at" is not null

llm_calls_items_check.name: llm_calls_items_check
llm_calls_items_check.value:
("llm_calls"."items_received" is null and "llm_calls"."items_accepted" is null)
          or ("llm_calls"."items_accepted" >= 0 and "llm_calls"."items_received" >= "llm_calls"."items_accepted")
